subject: Planner: Do not allow cardinality to go below 1 (#55242)
summary: Change clamps final row-count estimates to be >= 1 (unless table realtime count is 0) for column-range estimation and stats-v2 index-range estimation, with an optimizer fix-control (47400) to optionally restore allowing < 1; no remaining Blocker/High correctness/semantics/consistency/session/concurrency issues found in the touched planner/statistics/table areas relative to first parent, and later upstream history further refactors/removes the fix-control without indicating an unfixed critical issue.
